questions.text: What does Dr Owen advise Joel to include in the title of his project?
Why has Joel decided to do face-to-face interviews?

options.t: to limit the time he spends on the project

questions.text: Joel agrees to investigate how farmers get information on new developments

options.t: by showing them a series of pictures.
by sending them a checklist in advance.

questions.text: Concerning government communication with farmers, the speakers agree that

options.t: it is often insufficient for farmers' needs.

questions.text: According to Joel's reading about the cost of making changes, many British farmers

options.t: leave investment decisions to their accountants.
have too little time to calculate the costs of new methods.
are reluctant to spend money on improvements.

questions.text: A survey of Australian sheep farmers found that most of them

options.t: are usually reluctant to make changes.
make changes based on limited research.
want plenty of evidence before they make changes.
